title: intent.action body v1
description: Brain -> act: run a tool. jv-act's own registry is AUTHORITATIVE for capability/confirmation — the fields here are the brain's claim and act re-derives them; a mismatch is rejected in action.result. Envelope conf = 1.0.

request_id.description: UUID minted by the requester; threads intent.action -> action.confirm -> action.result and the audit log.

args.description: Tool arguments; validated by jv-act against the tool's own args schema from the registry.

capability.description: Capability level the requester believes applies (registry re-checked by act).

needs_confirmation.description: Requester's claim; act decides from the registry regardless.

utterance_id.description: Voice provenance: the input utterance that led here.
